Fund balances 917,518 / 1,101,599 (p4); ending cash = the four cash lines of the governmental funds balance sheet (p3), certificates of deposit 180,252 in investments; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the business-type statement (p6): receipts = operating receipts 191,216 + interest 7,497 + insurance proceeds 542; disbursements = operating 185,353 + loan payments 39,616 = 224,969 (printed on the Statement of Activities p2); the transfer is printed 'Operating transfer in' (105,209) as an outflow. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3; totals equal the government-wide 1,101,599), business-type from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: the only supplementary schedule is the all-funds budgetary comparison (p7, fund totals only), so detail is one line per fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4; 'Other Governmental' = Library and Park) and the business-type statement (p6); Water/Sewer expenditure and Sewer revenue totals cited from p7.
